<!--
Thank you for contributing to the Tech-Friendly Law School Ranking.

This ranking is only as good as its data. All submissions require a source URL
and a verification date. Anonymous submissions are welcome — contributors are
credited in the commit history by their GitHub username, not by name.

Please fill in as many sections as possible. Partial submissions are welcome;
a partial submission with good sources is better than a complete submission
with no sources.

IMPORTANT: All source URLs must point to primary sources (official school websites,
official course catalogs, official faculty pages). Screenshots or web archives
(archive.org) are acceptable as supplementary evidence.
-->

## Submission type

- [ ] New school (not yet in the ranking)
- [ ] Correction to an existing record
- [ ] Addition of courses/programs to an existing record
- [ ] Status update (a previously listed program is now inactive, or vice versa)
